citation: Altun, Bleda & Trindle, "Hydrogen Bonding in 3-hydroxy-2-butenamide and related isomers", Molecules 26, 2623 (2021), doi:10.3390/molecules26092623
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only; SI coordinates copied unchanged
topic: Two computed conformers of acetoacetamide and its enol tautomer are attached: conformer_ONE.xyz and conformer_ELEVEN.xyz (rows counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines). Both contain an NH···O= hydrogen bond.

facts.text: In ONE the amide N (row 9) donates its H (row 11) to the ketone carbonyl O (row 8).
facts.locator: SI coordinates, system ONE; main text Fig. 1

facts.text: In ELEVEN the amino N (row 3) donates its H (row 5) to the carbonyl O (row 13).
facts.locator: SI coordinates, system ELEVEN; main text Fig. 5

facts.text: Splitting between the antisymmetric and symmetric NH2 stretching frequencies (MP2/cc-pVTZ): ONE 159 cm^-1, ELEVEN 308 cm^-1; NH2 groups that take part in no hydrogen bond show about 120 cm^-1.
At the H···O bond critical point the energy density H = G + V is positive (mainly electrostatic) for ONE and negative (partly covalent) for ELEVEN.

ask: Compute the N···O distance in ONE minus that in ELEVEN (in Å), and choose the conclusion about the two NH···O= bonds. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

error.reason: 量成 H···O 距离之差，而不是给体–受体（N···O）距离之差。

paper.text: ELEVEN has the stronger NH···O= bond: its N···O contact is shorter, its NH2 stretches split about twice as much, and its critical point shows partial covalent character; the same bond type differs in strength with geometry.
paper.locator: NH2 modes: larger shift in ELEVEN attributed to the shorter N···O distance; AIM: H < 0 only for TWO, FIVE, ELEVEN

rejected.text: The two bonds are equally strong because they are the same type (NH···O=); the differences in distance and spectra are incidental.
rejected.reason: 原文明确把 ELEVEN 更大的 NH 伸缩分裂归因于更短的 N···O 距离，强度排序 ELEVEN > ONE。

scale.definition: N···O 给体–受体距离（约 0.27–0.28 nm）

notes: SI 中 ELEVEN 表下标注 N···O = 2.617 Å（正文同），但 SI 坐标算得 2.664 Å；ONE 的 2.789 Å 与坐标一致。本题以坐标为准，结论（ELEVEN 更短）不受影响。
